turnover_under_rebound_stacked_on_produc.classification_evidence: Week-blocked 95% interval [-2.1697,+0.4617] pts crosses zero (probability_positive 0.0867), so the whole-interval-below-zero test for a resolved wrong sign fails on this blocking even though the season-blocked secondary [-1.4839,-0.1447] pts (probability_positive 0.0050) is entirely negative. AGENTS.md requires BOTH blockings' whole interval on the wrong side of zero before wrong_sign_resolved is admissible; that is not met here, so this stays unresolved_below_power and the challenger registration is NOT declined on this reading.

turnover_under_rebound_stacked_on_produc.plain_summary: Adding the turnover-luck rebound pick-flip on top of the overlays already being tracked looks like it costs about 0.9 accuracy points on the 2020-2025 opener archive, but one of the two ways we measured the range still allows for a small gain, so this reading alone doesn't settle the question -- the challenger keeps generating its own live 2026 evidence either way.
